overview: The Medford City Council approved a Home Rule petition regarding Wright's Pond residency restrictions and a settlement agreement for former Brooks Estate caretakers. The Council also received an informational presentation on the Community Preservation Act ballot initiative and referred a proposal regulating condominium conversions to committee.

items.title: Home Rule Petition on Wright's Pond
items.summary: Approved a Home Rule petition to clarify and establish that beach and facility access at Wright's Pond can be restricted to Medford residents and their invitees.

items.title: Settlement Agreement for Brooks Estate Caretakers
items.summary: Approved a $24,000 settlement agreement to terminate the caretaker agreement at Brooks Estate due to lead hazards. A related motion passed requesting a meeting with the estate management trust to review finances and maintenance plans.

items.title: DPW Union Contract Appropriation
items.summary: Tabled a wage and personnel transfer request related to the DPW union contract for one week pending union ratification.

items.title: Community Preservation Act Presentation
items.summary: Received an informational presentation and heard public testimony on Question 1, the Community Preservation Act ballot initiative.

items.title: Public Participation: Leaf Pickup and Police Staffing
items.summary: Approved motions requesting an extension of leaf collection services and adding police staffing and substance abuse concerns to an upcoming subcommittee agenda.

items.title: National Grid Gas Main Extension Grant of Location
items.summary: Approved National Grid's petition to extend a gas main 55 feet at 26 Westville Road.

items.title: Condominium Conversion Regulations Resolution
items.summary: Referred a resolution exploring regulations governing condominium conversions to the Housing and Elder Affairs Subcommittee.

items.title: Public Presentation on City Leadership Model
items.summary: Received and placed on file a presentation request regarding the city leadership model after the presenter opted to defer discussion.

items.title: Commendations, Condolences, and Routine Business
items.summary: Approved birth congratulations, awareness month recognitions, meeting minutes, and condolences for several recently deceased residents.
